title.narrative: INNOVATE4CITIES: A RESEARCH-PRACTICE-INNOVATION NEXUS FOR ACCELERATED CLIMATE CHANGE ACTION

description.narrative:
The Innovate4Cities Conference series seeks to support city climate change ambitions through promoting, guiding and sharing city-focused and city-friendly research and innovation.
The Conference, convened by the Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate and Energy (GCoM), UN Habitat, and key partners, will guide cities and local government and all urban stakeholders to the evidence to make the case for ambitious action on climate change, and innovative processes, pathways and partnerships to deliver it; convening every two years in a cycle that supports contributions to key Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change assessment reports.
The Innovate4Cities conference will focus on both the research and innovative solutions: technologies, policies and processes needed for cities to meet their climate action ambition and to accelerate development and implementation at the regional and city levels, especially focusing on ways that make them stronger and more resilient to social and environmental disruptions.
The outcomes of the conference are to:
Demonstrate routes to resilient net zero cities: Showcasing innovative practices and solutions
Raise the voice of city innovators: Strengthening the focus on urban and regional issues in the IPCC and UNFCCC, especially at COP 26 and in the IPCC AR7 cycle
Advance science and practice together: Amending and filling the research gaps identified by the Global Research and Action Agenda, in particular in light of the COVID-19 pandemic
If these outcomes are achieved, then the climate change and cities science-policy nexus can be strengthened, the IPCC’s academic process can be informed by city practice and innovation, and the new partnerships and programmes that emerge at and after the conference can help to deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement.
